text: Git branching is an important part of a good version control workflow. When you work on a new feature, you create a feature branch instead of changing the main code directly. This keeps your work separate and safe. When the feature is ready, you merge the branch back into the main branch. Before merging, teams often open a pull request, where other people can review your changes and leave comments. This process helps catch mistakes early and keeps the project organised. Learning to use branches, merging and pull requests will make you a much more confident developer.
